purpose: Verify consistent terminology across the paper. Catch sign errors and forbidden phrases.

terms_checked.DeltaE: MUST equal E_delivered - E_requested. <0 = unmet demand. =0 = demand met. >0 = over-delivery. (Stage 6 Part A corrected from a Stage 5 prose flip.)
terms_checked.Delta d: MUST equal d_requested - d_actual. >0 = early departure. =0 = on time. <0 = late.
terms_checked.F0: Deterministic. rho_d = 1.0, rho_p = 0.1, rho_cap = 0.5, P_target = 6.6 kW, P_site_max = 9.9 kW.
terms_checked.F1: Scenario-averaged robust with K=8 (frozen). Smooth two-sided site cap. Corrected Stage 6 scenario transformation (variable set fixed + M_window diagonal).
terms_checked.F2: F1 with rho_d scaled by gamma (ADOPT, alpha=1.0 frozen). Single-solve, no online feedback.
terms_checked.F3: ORACLE / ANALYSIS ONLY. Not deployable. Uses realized (Delta d, DeltaE) at evaluation time. Establishes an upper bound only.
terms_checked.ADOPT: Adaptive deadline penalty. Single scalar gamma computed from calibration joint. Frozen before held-out use. NOT a generic penalty adaptation framework.
terms_checked.QAOA: Standard variational quantum optimizer. p=1 default. COBYLA. Seeds [0,1,2]. 1024 shots. Aer statevector simulator.
terms_checked.calibration: 2018-05-01 .. 2019-07-01 UTC. All uncertainty fits use calibration only.
terms_checked.placeholder: Stage 5/6 synthetic mixture. NOT real ACN-Data.
terms_checked.synthetic: Stage 7 controlled distributions (S1/S2/S3, A/B/C). NOT real ACN-Data.
terms_checked.real ACN-Data: BLOCKED on ACN_API_TOKEN. Not acquired in this project (Stage 9).
